name: disguise-mcp
description: Control a disguise media server from Claude over the disguise Designer API: drive the timeline transport, sequencing, notes, media and every other API section.
long_description: disguise-mcp bridges the disguise Designer API to the Model Context Protocol. It exposes the entire Designer API as tools (generated from disguise's OpenAPI specs) — transport/playback, sequencing, notes, colour, media, system and more — and can be repointed at any disguise server. Point the Host setting at your disguise machine's IP.

host.title: disguise server host
host.description: Hostname or IP of the disguise server running the Designer API. Use 127.0.0.1 only if this bridge runs on the disguise machine itself.

config_path.title: Config file
config_path.description: Optional path to a disguise-mcp YAML config file (overrides host/port and sets enabled API sections).

web_enabled.title: Enable admin console
web_enabled.description: Serve the admin console (default on 0.0.0.0:8091) for viewing status and repointing the disguise target.

tools.name: disguise_status
tools.description: Show which disguise server is targeted and whether it is reachable.

tools.name: disguise_set_target
tools.description: Repoint the bridge at a different disguise server.

tools.name: disguise_raw
tools.description: Call any disguise Designer API endpoint directly.
